headline: GOLIATH SUREBET: 7.38 g/t AUEQ OVER 35.7m, 19.51 g/t OVER 8.32m — GOLDEN TRIANGLE DISCOVERY STILL OPEN
snippet: Goliath Resources Ltd. (TSXV: GOT) released new assay results August 21, 2026 from its 50,000-metre drill program at the Surebet Discovery on the Golddigger Property in British Columbia's Golden Triangle. Lead hole GD-26-436 returned 7.38 g/t AuEq over 35.7 metres including a high-grade core of 19.51 g/t AuEq over 8.32 metres near surface — adding to a discovery that has now returned 52 of 98 planned drill holes totalling 31,994 metres drilled in 2026. Multiple additional holes in the batch confirmed broad mineralized intervals throughout the Surebet Zone, with gold-silver veining, alteration, and anomalous grades throughout their length. The discovery remains open in all directions, and Goliath is fully-funded for the balance of the program through mid-December. For retail investors watching the Golden Triangle — one of Canada's most prolific discovery belts — Surebet is shaping up as one of the standout high-grade targets of the 2026 drill season.

headline: SILVER MINERS CRUSH GOLD IN AUGUST: GOGOLD +36%, MCEWEN +23%, HECLA POSTS Q2 EARNINGS BEAT WITH NEW HIGH-GRADE VEINS
snippet: Silver equities massively outperformed the underlying metal in August 2026, with spot silver surging roughly 20% to touch $70 an ounce on August 21 — up from $57.59 at end of July — while silver mining stocks amplified those gains several times over. Standout movers include GoGold Resources (+36.54%), McEwen Mining (+23.18%), SSR Mining (+22.27%), and Pan American Silver (+21.74%). Hecla Mining posted a separate catalyst: a powerful Q2 2026 earnings beat alongside fresh exploration success that uncovered new high-grade silver veins at the Keno Hill and Midas properties. The silver equity rally reflects the 'dual demand' dynamic playing out in the metal: safe-haven flows stacking on top of industrial consumption from solar, EVs, and AI data centres, with China having reclassified silver as a strategic material at the start of 2026. For investors in TSX-V and ASX silver juniors, the equity leverage thesis is finally playing out in real time at record-near spot prices.

headline: OSISKO METALS GASPÉ COPPER: 312 METRES AT 0.56% CU — SOUTH ZONE GRADE EXPANDS BEYOND CURRENT PIT MODEL
snippet: Osisko Metals Inc. (TSX: OM) announced August 20, 2026, new results from the 2026 drill program at the Gaspé Copper Project in Eastern Québec, led by drill hole 30-1223 — a vertical infill hole positioned near the southern margin of the current mineral resource estimate model — which returned 312.5 metres averaging 0.56% copper. CEO Robert Wares stated that holes 30-1218 and 30-1223 in particular are adding higher-grade material within and below the current pit volume, expanding the deposit to the south. The overall 2026 program presented 35 mineralized intercepts from 15 new drill holes, with grade improving in the southern extension. At copper near $6.58 per pound, Gaspé's 312-metre intersection underscores the value being added in one of Québec's most significant advanced copper porphyry projects — a jurisdiction that combines political stability with established mining infrastructure.

headline: COT GOLD: SPECS POST HIGHEST 1-WEEK NET-LONG RISE IN 10 WEEKS — 217,900 CONTRACTS AS DOLLAR HITS 3-MONTH LOW
snippet: The CFTC Commitment of Traders (COT) data released Friday August 21, 2026 (reflecting positions as of August 18) showed gold large speculators and managed funds adding to net-long positions at the fastest weekly rate in the past ten weeks, bringing total gold net-long exposure to approximately 217,900 contracts. The surge in bullish institutional positioning coincides with the US Dollar Index hitting a three-month low, the Federal Reserve's rate-hike odds collapsing from 50% to 31% on consecutive soft macro prints, and the Treasury's surprise expansion of longer-dated bond purchases pushing yields lower. Meanwhile, silver speculator positioning tells a different story: silver's COT Strength Score sits at just 21% — the weakest among all metals in the complex — indicating that despite spot silver touching $70 on August 21, managed fund positioning in silver futures remains cautiously below historical averages. For retail junior mining investors, the divergence between silver's price strength and its relatively light speculative positioning is often read as a sign the move has more runway.

headline: NEXGOLD GOLDBORO NOVA SCOTIA RC INFILL: 5.26 g/t AU OVER 7m AND 7.08 g/t AU OVER 5m CONFIRM RESOURCE GRADE
snippet: NexGold Mining Corp. announced August 19, 2026 results from its 40,000-metre Reverse Circulation infill drill program at the Goldboro Gold Project in Nova Scotia, Canada. Key intercepts include 5.26 g/t gold over 7.0 metres and 7.08 g/t gold over 5.0 metres, with grades and intercept widths consistent with the deposit's existing resource model. The RC infill program is designed to convert inferred resources to indicated ahead of a feasibility study and provides statistical confidence in the continuity of Goldboro's high-grade gold zones. Nova Scotia's provincial government has been actively streamlining mining permitting in 2025–2026, making Goldboro — one of Atlantic Canada's largest advanced gold development projects — an increasingly de-risked jurisdiction story alongside the grade story.

headline: LABRADOR GOLD TAKES US$1.41M STAKE IN BOLIVIAN SAN CRISTOBAL SILVER-ZINC-LEAD MINE OPERATOR
snippet: Labrador Gold Corp. (TSXV: LAB) announced August 20, 2026 the completion of a US$1,410,000 strategic investment in San Cristobal Mining Inc., which operates the San Cristobal silver-zinc-lead mine in Bolivia — one of the world's largest silver-producing mines by volume. The investment gives Labrador a direct exposure to operating silver production at a time when silver has hit $70 per ounce, providing a cash-flow and optionality bridge while the company advances its own Kingsway gold project in Newfoundland. The San Cristobal mine has historically produced over 20 million ounces of silver annually as a by-product of zinc and lead production. The move reflects a growing trend among junior gold and silver explorers of adding strategic positions in producing assets to improve balance sheet resilience while retaining their exploration-stage growth optionality.

headline: AZTEC MINERALS TOMBSTONE ARIZONA: 88.4m AT 1.69 g/t AUEQ IN FIRST NORTH EXTENSION STEP-OUT — NEW ZONE CONFIRMED
snippet: Aztec Minerals Corp. released results from the first step-out holes into the recently acquired North Extension Zone at its 100%-owned Tombstone Property in southeastern Arizona, highlighted by an 88.4-metre interval averaging 1.42 g/t gold and 14.58 g/t silver (1.69 g/t AuEq) from reverse circulation drilling. The North Extension Zone sits adjacent to Aztec's existing Tombstone resource and was acquired to test geological continuity along strike. The 88.4-metre intercept — one of the longest gold-silver intervals reported at Tombstone to date — confirms that mineralization extends into the North Extension area, opening a new resource expansion vector. The Tombstone district in Arizona has a long historic mining legacy; Aztec's modern exploration is demonstrating that untested extensions of the existing system carry significant grade and width. Results were published via GoldSeek, a preferred precious metals news aggregator.

headline: HECLA MINING Q2 2026: SILVER EARNINGS BEAT AND NEW HIGH-GRADE VEINS DISCOVERED AT KENO HILL AND MIDAS
snippet: Hecla Mining Company (NYSE: HL) shares surged in the week ending August 22, 2026 on a combination of silver's 20% August price advance and a Q2 2026 earnings beat that surprised the market in both silver production volumes and realised prices. Beyond the financial results, Hecla disclosed fresh exploration success: new high-grade silver veins were uncovered at the Keno Hill Silver District in Yukon, Canada and at the Midas property in Nevada — two assets that anchor Hecla's long-term reserve replacement thesis. Keno Hill, acquired from Alexco in 2022, has been repositioning as a multi-decade high-grade silver district; new vein discoveries extending the ore system at depth and along strike would represent a material uplift to Hecla's resource base. At spot silver above $68–70 per ounce, Hecla's operating margins have expanded dramatically, providing cash flow to accelerate the exploration programs that drive future reserve growth.

headline: GLOBAL MINING STOCKS SURGE $206B IN AUGUST, OUTPACING BIG TECH — GOLD AND SILVER EQUITIES CONTRIBUTE $108B
snippet: Global mining equities added approximately $206 billion in market capitalisation in August 2026, outpacing the Big Tech sector and reversing two years of relative underperformance versus technology stocks, according to IndexBox analysis. Gold and silver companies accounted for roughly $108 billion of that gain — just over half — as spot gold held above $4,500 per ounce and silver surged 20% to touch $70. The August advance has pushed the total market capitalisation of publicly traded mining companies to a historic high in nominal terms, reflecting not only higher commodity prices but also meaningful multiple re-rating as institutional investors acknowledge the structural earnings improvement embedded in current cost structures. For retail investors tracking TSX-V and ASX juniors, the macro capital flow story matters: major and senior producer outperformance typically precedes capital cascading down to mid-tiers and then juniors by six to twelve months.

headline: KALKINE: TOP CANADIAN GOLD, COPPER AND URANIUM STOCKS TO WATCH AS GOLD CLEARS $4,600 IN AUGUST 2026
snippet: Kalkine Media's August 2026 round-up of Canadian mining equities spans three commodity categories — gold, copper, and uranium — identifying names that have the strongest combination of near-term catalysts and valuation support at current metal prices. The piece targets Canadian-listed companies specifically: TSX and TSX-V names where domestic investors have easier access to management, regulatory filings, and investor relations. At gold above $4,600, copper near $6.58 per pound (with the US tariff ruling still pending), and uranium spot at approximately $88.50 per pound driven by AI-data-centre nuclear demand, all three sectors are offering some of the best margin conditions in a decade. Kalkine's framework identifies companies where the commodity tailwind is being converted into operating cash flow, reserve growth, or near-term development milestones — the three screens most relevant to retail investors building positions in Canadian resource equities.
